title: Days since last check-in
hints: datetime.fromisoformat handles '+02:00' offsets but on Python 3.9 not a trailing 'Z'. Replace the Z with '+00:00' first.
An aware datetime has dt.tzinfo set. If it is None, dt.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) makes it aware; dt.astimezone(timezone.utc) converts any offset to UTC.
Subtracting two aware datetimes gives a timedelta whose .days is already rounded down; wrap it in max(0, ...) for the future case.
